title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（田中吉史研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Tanaka Yoshifumi)
educationalGoal: Students carry out psychological research activities, i.e., set their own research questions, collect data, carry out analysis, and prepare reports, while using the knowledge they have learned so far.　Examining phenomena and data from various perspectives, students are expected to be able to discover and organize problems by themselves, and to tackle their own research issues.
advice:
We conduct seminars regularly throughout the year, and students report and discuss their own activities and deepen their own research. When reporting in the seminar, please prepare a resume or slide presentation (submit the electronic file of the resume or slides later).
Spring semester: Reading prior research papers related to the research theme and discussing with class members, clarifying the overall picture of your research. Specifically, the research purpose, research positioning, and methods for empirical data collection are clarified and a research schedule is established. In addition, preliminary experiments/surveys will be conducted. The results will be reported at the interim presentation at the end of the semester.
Fall Semester: Based on the results of preliminary experiments/surveys, modify the plan for the experiments /surveys as necessary, conduct the main experiments/surveys, analyze the results, and deepen the discussion. Students will write a research paper, and give an oral presentation at the end of the year.
books: Reference books and research articles are presented during the course.
requiredKnowledge:
・Prepare a notebook and make a habit of taking notes on the documents. It is not only useful for writing papers later, but it is also very useful for expanding and organizing ideas.
・Review the data collection and statistical analysis methods learned in previous classes.
・To conduct research effectively, familiarize yourself with the specifications of the equipment and teachers in the laboratory.

activityGoals.body: Ability to discuss various problems around us from a psychological point of view.
Ability to choose a research method for the research theme, and conduct experimental design.
Ability to conduct the experiment, and obtain the data to fulfill the purpose.
Ability to interpret the obtained data objectively and write a thesis.
Ability to notice your role in seminar activities, and act in cooperation with other class members.
Ability to draft an action agenda for your future career.

achievementLevels.ideal: While utilizing the knowledge and techniques learned so far, the students will acquire new knowledge and techniques and explore their own themes. Then, they conduct a presentation of their results and write a research paper. In addition, students obtain a solid action guide on future courses with further research themes.
